sana: Quick heads-up 94 I'm starting a tiny refresh for the quickstart "Hello One-Click". Goals: unify env var names, add a one-command run, fix the broken SDK v9 link, and add a minimal smoke test. I'll open a draft PR under examples/hello-oneclick.

rob: Nice. One-command UX = `npm ci && npm run dev`? Keep Docker option but make dev path the simplest for newcomers.

sana: Exactly. Plan: provide .env.sample and a start wrapper script that loads env if present. README will show `cp .env.sample .env && npm ci && npm run dev`. Snippets I'll add:```bash
# .env.sample
HELLO_API_KEY=your_api_key_here
HELLO_REGION=us-west1
```

mike: Can we standardize on HELLO_API_KEY across all quickstarts? There's ongoing confusion with OLD_API_TOKEN.

sana: Yes. I'll add a migration section: "Legacy token names: if you used OLD_API_TOKEN, set HELLO_API_KEY=OLD_API_TOKEN_VALUE in your secrets or rename it in your CI."

rob: Also replace the old SDK doc link that 404s with https://sdk.redwood.ai/v9/quickstart. I'll add a docs CI linkcheck that fails on 404s.

link-bot: queued: docs/linkcheck for PR draft.

mike: For reviewers: @rob take CI/linkcheck, @sana handle examples and start script, I'll do copy and screenshots.

sana: Draft PR #4999 created. PR checklist in description: - add examples/hello-oneclick - .env.sample + start script - update README quick run steps - point SDK link to v9 - add migration note for OLD_API_TOKEN - add docs CI linkcheck - add examples smoke test asserting /health returns 200

rob: I'll add the CI job: run linkcheck after build; run examples smoke test. Fail on linkcheck 404s.

link-bot: linkcheck: discovered broken link earlier; re-run pending after push.

sana: Pushed fix for start script (loads dotenv, respects env hierarchy). Short start.js:```js
require('dotenv').config();
const http = require('http');
const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3000;
http.createServer((req,res)=> res.end('hello')).listen(PORT);
```

mike: Small accessibility nit: update alt text for screenshot to "Hello One-Click sample app UI".

sana: Added to PR. Also kept Dockerfile snippet for on-prem docs.

link-bot: linkcheck: external links OK. examples smoke: passing.

rob: LGTM from CI side. Merge if docs review passes.

mike: Approved with tiny copy edit.

sana: Merged PR #4999. Will post a short note in #announcements after deploy. Thanks!
